newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Record trade lifts volumes.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Record trade lifts volumes.

text.p: Traded volumes rose on the Lusaka Stock Exchange in the week ended August 30, as a record 140 million Zambia Sugar shares changed hands, exchange officials said.
They said volumes rose to 140 million shares valued at 1.5 billion kwacha, up from 353,273 shares worth 2,6 million kwacha the previous week.

The Zambia Privatisation Trust Fund and the Commonweath Development Corporation on August 26 simultaneously put up for sale 164.5 million Zambian Sugar shares ahead of the listing of the company on the exchange on September 27.
Chilanga cement remained steady at 48 kwacha and saw seven trades during the week, with a volume of 4,382 shares worth 210,336 kwacha.
Rothmans gained two kwacha to end the week at 40 kwacha in a traded volume of 1,150 kwacha worth 45,800.
Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines saw no trades during the week.
Meanwhile, the Zambian Privatisation Agency announced the sale of metal fabricators of Zambia and the acquisition of a controlling interest by Phelps Dodge, the American mining company.
